_note: Golden clause set. Written separately from the rule examples, in different words, so it tests if the system generalises. 'rule' = the rule a human expert would cite (used for retrieval scoring); 'verdict' = the expected verdict. 'rule': null means no specific rule applies.

clauses.text: Tenant agrees to provide a refundable security deposit of $800 prior to occupancy.
A pet fee of $300 is required for any cat or dog living in the unit.
Absolutely no dogs or cats.
Should rent be late by more than five days, interest of 2% per month will be added to the balance.
Tenant shall deliver a series of post-dated cheques covering the full term.
The landlord or the landlord's agents may access the suite at their discretion.
Upon expiry of this lease the tenant agrees to vacate the premises.
The landlord reserves the right to raise the rent at any time.
Rent shall increase by 3% every quarter.
All maintenance and repair costs are the responsibility of the tenant.
The landlord may disconnect hydro service if rent is not paid.
In case of default, the landlord may retain the tenant's personal property.
Tenant may not sublet the premises.
A one-time administration fee of $150 is payable upon signing.
Tenant must pay three months' rent in advance.
The tenant gives up the right to apply to the Landlord and Tenant Board.
If the cheque bounces, a $50 administration charge applies plus bank fees.
Landlord will charge $2 for every rent receipt issued.
All future rent becomes immediately payable if the tenant breaches any term.
Utilities may be suspended for non-payment.
The landlord can keep the tenant's furniture if the tenant leaves owing rent.
The lessee shall not keep animals of any description in the dwelling.
Late payments will incur a $25 charge.
A cleaning deposit of $250 is collected at move-in.
Guests may not stay overnight more than 3 nights per month.
Tenant shall give at least 120 days' notice before leaving.
This agreement is used instead of the provincial standard lease form.
Rent of $1,650 is due on the 1st of each month.
Tenant is responsible for the electricity bill.
Proof of tenant liability insurance must be provided at move-in.
The tenant will compensate the landlord for damage resulting from the tenant's negligence.
No smoking of any substance is allowed on the property.
A last month's rent deposit of $1,650 is required.
Two key fobs are provided against a refundable $40 deposit.
The landlord will provide written notice at least 24 hours before any entry.
Garbage and recycling must be placed in the bins provided.
The rental unit includes one parking spot in the underground garage.
This lease is governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario.
The tenant will keep the rental unit reasonably clean.
Assignment of this lease requires the landlord's prior written consent.
The landlord is responsible for repairs to appliances supplied with the unit.
Water and heat are included; tenant pays internet.
If an NSF cheque is returned, tenant pays the bank charge and a $20 fee.
The landlord may enter without notice in an emergency such as a fire or flood.
Either party may end a monthly tenancy by giving proper written notice under the Residential Tenancies Act.
